style.name: Canadian Group of Seven oil studies — revised examples
style.scope: Rendering and presentation only; subject, red cloak and medieval equipment are not templates.
style.treatment: Large rhythmic colour/value masses first; varied directional opaque oil strokes, quieter connecting passages, selective substantial impasto. Figures/heads/machines simplified as decisively as reference landscape forms; quiet ivory ground. Story-specific motivated light; connected subdued coloured shadow families; no individually bevel-lit strokes, theatrical rim light, glossy eyes/lenses or automatic orange-blue contrast. Palette/light adapted to story environment within same painterly approach.
style.format: Landscape 3:2, warm ivory support, exact character name and story title, isolated full-form views and distinguishing details/states/equipment. No location/scenic vignette, terrain/ground patch, buildings or environmental backdrop. Character material and restrained lighting remain story-specific. No paint swatches or palette strips.
